searchText: Sadly not just a clarification. A necessary normative change to 2930. 😢 here's a block number for goerli berlin hf https://github.com/goerli/testnet/pull/75 What about `9_710_179` for Ropsten? https://github.com/ethereum/ropsten/issues/38 not sure about rinkeby. is kovan still considred an ethereum testnet? also did we consider diff delay along with berlin? https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3238 I cannot find notes for meeting 105 I am considering kovan as testnet. ok, it's kind of messy to maintain for other clients due to the wasm vm. but if the community wants berlin, they could also come up with a block number. Agreed, we want to disable wasm in kovan with this hard fork, it is not used and we intend to remove wasm entirely from OE. The target for the next difficulty bomb delay was London, we have until ~July before it starts measurably impacting block times. Yeah, we discussed it on the last ACD and agreed to push it back this summer 👍 RE the updates for 2030. Any sense on how that fits with client readiness for next friday? I don't want to merge the block numbers for the the testnet until we get a sense for its effect. sorry what is 2030? 2930* ^ this change here. Merged ✅ **AllCoreDevs agendas are now here: https://github.com/ethereum/pm#agendas** If you'd like to add anything for the next call (or one in the future), please open an issue on the `ethereum/pm` repo 👍
